svg.title: What runs where
svg.desc: In your Claude Code session, Claude directs: reads the request, writes the script and scenes, shows a first look, briefs the crew, checks the result. On your machine, in ~/.showtime: headless Chrome, ffmpeg, local voices, Whisper transcripts, a composer with 18 styles and 56 effect types, 1,334 licensed sounds, Manim, showtime qa. The web only when you ask: archive search and website capture. No cloud AI service, no API keys, no uploads.
